name: 3D Wavelet Construction via Tensor Product
definition: 3D wavelets are constructed using a tensor product approach from 1D scaling functions $\phi$ and wavelets $\psi$. For a semi-orthonormal set of functions $\{\phi(x - p) | p \in \mathbf{Z}\}$, the set $\{\phi^3(x - p, y - q, z - r) | p, q, r \in \mathbf{Z}\}$ forms a semi-orthonormal basis for $V_0^3 \subset L^2(\mathbb{R}^3)$.
summary: This method constructs separable 3D wavelets by taking the tensor product of 1D functions, enabling efficient volumetric data decomposition and reconstruction.
